Name: Dr. Bradley Buck MD
Bio:
Dr. Bradley Buck was born and raised in Toledo, Ohio. He attended Maumee Valley Country Day School for K-8, and graduated from Saint John’s Jesuit High School. At Saint John's Dr. Buck excelled in both academics and athletics. His efforts afforded him admission to the University of Michigan - Ann Arbor, and earned him varsity letters in both soccer and hockey.

At the University of Michigan Dr. Buck was involved in a multitude of biomedical research. He authored several papers, meeting abstracts, and a book chapter. In addition he was named director of a laboratory at the medical school, and graduated with high honors in biology. Following graduation he obtained a masters degree from Georgetown University in physiology and biophysics before making his way back home to Toledo for medical school and residency.

To this day Dr. Buck continues to excel. He is the recent author of several urology publications, and a popular textbook for aspiring urology medical students. As a chief resident he scored in the top 1% of the nation on his yearly in-training examination, and was recently recognized as having one of the top scores on his urology board exam. He obtained advanced training in urethral reconstruction surgery post residency with Dr. Guido Barbagli in Italy. Outside the office Dr. Buck enjoys spending time with his wife Molly and two children. They are avid travelers and cyclists.
MD Degree: University of Toledo College of Medicine 2012
Internship: General Surgery - University of Toledo Department of Surgery 2012-2014
Residency: University of Toledo Department of Urologic Surgery and Renal Transplantation 2018
Clinical Interests: Robotic-Assisted Urologic Surgery, Complex Urethral Reconstruction, Kidney Stone Management and Prevention, Female Voiding Dysfunction and Incontinence, Complex Prostate Cancer Care, and Management of Benign Prostate Enlargement, Restoration of male sexual health and male incontinence.

Name: Dr. Daniel Murtagh Jr. MD
Bio:
Dr. Daniel Murtagh Jr. was born in Toledo, Ohio.  He attended St Francis De Sales High School in Toledo before attending Miami University of Ohio, and received a Bachelor of Science.  He then completed his Masters degree of Science and Biomedical Sciences at the University of Toledo. He was able to stay in Toledo to obtain his medical degree for four years, and then continued for six years of training in Urology and Renal Transplantation at the University of Toledo Medical Center.

Dr. Murtagh Jr. treats a wide variety of urologic disorders.  He practices compassionate medicine and tailors his practice to the needs of each patient.  Part of his practice is dedicated to medical education and is involved with teaching residents.  

Dr. Murtagh Jr. enjoys spending time with his wife and three children, fishing, hunting, biking, golfing, and traveling.
MD Degree: University of Toledo College of Medicine 2012
Internship: General Surgery - University of Toledo Department of Surgery 2012-2014
Residency: University of Toledo Department of Urologic Surgery and Renal Transplantation 2018
Clinical Interests: Robotic-assisted surgery, Prostate diseases, Kidney Stones including complex stone disease, Urologic Cancers, Minimally Invasive Prostate and Kidney Surgery, Female Urology, Incontinence, Erectile Dysfunction.

Name: Dr. Dino Santacroce MD
Bio:
Dr. Dino Santacroce is a native of Toledo, Ohio and a graduate of St. Francis DeSales High School. Following this he attended The Ohio State University for his bachelor degree and the University of Toledo for his medical doctorate. He then continued at The University of Toledo Medical Center for an additional six years of training in Urology and Renal Transplantation.

Dr. Santacroce is devoted to treating all Urologic diseases, focusing on minimally invasive and robotic surgery. He obtained advanced training in robotic prostate, kidney, and bladder surgery during his six years of residency. He is passionate about treating benign and cancerous urologic diseases in all patients. In his practice, he utilizes both state-of-the-art and traditional treatments of Urologic disorders.

Dr. Santacroce has distinguished himself not only as an exemplary clinician, but also has been recognized for other Urologic achievements as well. He served on the board of the Ohio Urologic Society from 2009-2011 and has presented his research at multiple Urologic meetings at the local, state, and national levels. In addition, he was recognized for achieving the highest score in the nation on the annual Urology In-Service examination while in training.

Dr. Santacroce enjoys running, playing golf, and spending time with his family here in Toledo. He is excited about keeping his advanced training in Northwestern Ohio and providing cutting-edge Urologic care to the people of his hometown.
MD Degree: University of Toledo College of Medicine 2005
Internship: General Surgery - University of Toledo Department of Surgery 2005-2007
Residency: University of Toledo Department of Urologic Surgery and Renal Transplantation 2011
Clinical Interests: Laparoscopy, Robotic-assisted surgery, Prostate Diseases, Kidney Stones, Urologic Cancers, Minimally Invasive Prostate and Kidney Surgery, Female Urology, Incontinence, Erectile Dysfunction.​

Name: Dr. Hesham Mostafa MD
Bio:
Dr. Hesham Mostafa was born in Cleveland, Ohio.  He spent his childhood in both Cleveland and Toledo, Ohio. He attended The Ohio State University and received a Bachelor of Science in Microbiology and was awarded Magna Cum Laude and was on the Dean’s List all four years.

After completing his undergraduate studies at The Ohio State University, he went to the University Of Cincinnati College Of Medicine. He recently completed his residency in Urology at the University Of Toledo Medical College. He specializes in general urology, minimally invasive and advanced robotic surgeries. Dr. Mostafa holds an appointment as Chair of Robotic Surgery at a tertiary referral center and is a regional leader in Urologic Robotic Surgery.

Dr. Mostafa has a special interest in global health care. In the past he has done medical mission trips in the West Indies and West Africa. During these trips he and his team were able to perform surgeries varying from reconstruction, kidney transplantation, oncologic surgeries, and pediatric surgery. He enjoys sports, mountain biking, running, traveling and trying new cuisines.
MD Degree: University of Cincinnati College of Medicine 2011
Internship: General Surgery - University of Toledo Department of Surgery 2011-2013
Residency: University of Toledo Department of Urologic Surgery and Renal Transplantation 2017
Clinical Interests: Robotic-assisted surgery, Urologic Cancers, Robotic Prostatectomy, Robotic Nephrectomy, Robotic Partial Nephrectomy, Robotic Nephroureterectomy, Robotic Cystectomy, Robotic Pyeloplasty, Robotic Ureteral Reconstruction

Name: Dr. Mirza Baig MD
Bio:
Dr. Mirza Baig was born and raised in Southeast Michigan and graduated from the University of Michigan with a Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Mathematics. He went on to obtain a medical degree from the University Of Toledo College Of Medicine, where he also completed six years of training in Urologic Surgery and Kidney Transplantation. During his residency he went on sabbatical to learn from world-renowned Urologic surgeons at the Mayo Clinic and Cleveland Clinic. He then pursued further training in advanced robotic prostate and kidney surgery at Henry Ford Hospital under Dr. Mani Menon, where these techniques were once pioneered. He has served as the Director of Robotic Surgery at Mercy St Vincent for almost two decades and one of the highest volume robotic surgeons in the region.

Dr. Baig treats all adult urologic conditions including prostate disorders, stone disease, and incontinence. He is especially passionate about urologic cancer and robotic surgery. He has performed well over 2500 robotic surgeries for all types of urologic cancer (prostate, kidney, bladder, adrenal, ureter). In addition, Dr. Baig prides himself in his ability in teaching complex surgical techniques, having trained the majority of Urologists in the greater Toledo area over the last twenty years.

Most importantly, Dr. Baig holds himself to the highest standards of quality and strives to provide his patients the best possible outcomes. His caring and compassionate personality allows him to be uniquely sensitive to the needs of his patients, especially those facing serious illnesses such as cancer. He aims to provide his patients the type of care that he would want for himself and his family.

Dr. Baig is married with three children and enjoys biking, basketball, travelling and spending time with family. He is the president of Romius Urology and remains dedicated to offering his services to our Northwest Ohio community.
MD Degree: University of Toledo College of Medicine 2001
Internship: University of Toledo Department of Surgery 2001-2003
Residency: University of Toledo Department of Urologic Surgery and Renal Transplantation 2007
Clinical Interests: Robotic-assisted surgery, Urologic Cancers, Robotic Prostatectomy, Robotic Nephrectomy, Robotic Partial Nephrectomy, Robotic Nephroureterectomy, Robotic Cystectomy, Robotic Pyeloplasty, Robotic Ureteral Reconstruction

Name: Dr. Omar Khan MD
Bio:
Dr. Omar Khan is a native of Maumee, Ohio. He attended Maumee Valley Country Day School prior to attending the Ohio State University. He returned to Toledo to obtain his medical degree for four years and then continued for six years of training in Urology and Renal Transplantation at the University of Toledo Medical Center. 

Dr. Khan treats a wide variety of urologic disorders. He is the medical director and holds leadership positions at several regional hospitals and has a passion for improving health care access in Northwest and West Central Ohio.  Dr. Khan is also a dedicated educator who spends time teaching residents and advanced practice providers.  He is married with two children and enjoys spending time with his family, in addition to travelling, basketball, and music.
MD Degree: University of Toledo College of Medicine 2011
Internship: General Surgery - University of Toledo Department of Surgery 2011-2013
Residency: University of Toledo Department of Urologic Surgery and Renal Transplantation 2017
Clinical Interests: Advanced Prostate Cancer, Minimally Invasive Surgery, Robotic Surgery, BPH/Voiding dysfunction, Kidney Stones, Rural Healthcare delivery, Healthcare Access

Name: Dr. Saleem Zafar MD
Bio:
Dr. Saleem Zafar is a native of Toledo, Ohio. He attended Maumee Valley Country Day School prior to attending the University of Chicago. He returned to Toledo to obtain his medical degree and then continued for an additional six years of training in Urology and Renal Transplantation at the University of Toledo Medical Center.

Dr. Zafar is passionate about treating all urologic disorders with an emphasis on minimally invasive and robotic surgery. He obtained advanced training in robotic prostate, kidney, and bladder surgery at Henry Ford Hospital, where many robotic urologic procedures were pioneered. He enjoys treating benign and cancerous urologic diseases in both adults and children. He utilizes cutting-edge treatments whenever possible and traditional treatments when appropriate.

Dr. Zafar has distinguished himself not only as an exemplary clinician, but also has won several awards for his research at the local, regional, and national levels. He has also been recognized by the University of Toledo as one of the best educators on campus by being awarded the Arnold P. Gold Humanism in Medicine Award three times. He also won the John D. Silbar Award, given by the American Urologic Association annually for "outstanding qualities in clinical ability, high ethical and moral standards, compassion for patients, and outstanding bedside manner."

​Dr. Zafar currently serves as the Chairman of the Surgery Department at Mercy St Vincent Medical Center.  Additionally, he is the Director of the Laparoscopy, Simulation, and Robotics Center (LaSR) at Mercy St Vincent Hospital where he teaches and supervises the curriculum for simulation-based minimally invasive surgery for all surgical residents.  

Dr. Zafar is married and has two daughters. In addition to spending time with his family, he enjoys traveling, golfing, and running in his spare time.
MD Degree: University of Toledo College of Medicine 2001
Internship: Medical College of Ohio Department of Surgery 2002-2004
Residency: University of Toledo Department of Urologic Surgery and Renal Transplantation 2008
Clinical Interests: Clinical Interests: Laparoscopy, Robotic-assisted surgery, Prostate diseases, Kidney stones, Urologic Cancers, Minimally Invasive Prostate and Kidney Surgery, Female Urology, Incontinence, Erectile Dysfunction.
